info.name: List all transactions for the company

params.name: company_id
params.description: The company the transactions belong to

params.name: cursor
params.description:
The pagination cursor. A cursor is used to paginate through a large set of data.
It is a unique identifier that represents a specific position in the dataset.

params.name: expand
params.description: Fields that will be expanded. Expandable fields: `category`, `subcategory`, `reconciliations`, `reconciliations.flow`

params.name: filter
params.description: List of filters on the resource. Currently the fields that allow to be filtered are: `account_id`, `booking_date_time`, `clean_description`, `counterpart_name`, `date`, `type`

params.name: sort
params.description: Fields for which we can order the results. Sortable fields: `amount`, `created_at`, `date`

items.docs:
The return value is paginated. By default the response contains 25 elements per page but can be instructed to return more elements per page.
A cursor is needed to traverse the results.
